s1.syndrome_frame: Widespread skin condition with progressive worsening and characteristic plaques
salient_findings: Widespread polycyclic serpiginous, erythematous plaques with a double-edged scale
key_facts: 30% of BSA with polycyclic serpiginous, erythematous plaques
Skin biopsy showed psoriasiform epidermal hyperplasia with spongiosis
Trichography showed nodal swelling with invagination of the distal hair into the proximal end

raw.syndrome_frame: Widespread skin condition with progressive worsening and characteristic plaques
salient_findings: Widespread polycyclic serpiginous, erythematous plaques with a double-edged scale
key_facts: 30% of BSA with polycyclic serpiginous, erythematous plaques

Trichography showed nodal swelling with invagination of the distal hair into the proximal end

shortlist.label: Pityriasis rubra pilaris
shortlist.why_kept: Characterized by widespread erythematous plaques and palmoplantar keratoderma, matching the patient's presentation of a worsening skin condition with 90% BSA involvement and specific skin biopsy findings.

shortlist.label: Psoriasis vulgaris
shortlist.why_kept: The patient's skin biopsy showing psoriasiform epidermal hyperplasia with spongiosis is consistent with psoriasis, and the clinical presentation of erythematous plaques with a double-edged scale supports this diagnosis.

shortlist.label: Ichthyosis vulgaris
shortlist.why_kept: The patient's coarse and brittle scalp hairs and sparse eyebrow hairs could be indicative of ichthyosis vulgaris, which often presents with dry, scaly skin and hair abnormalities.

shortlist.label: Darier disease
shortlist.why_kept: The combination of skin and hair findings, including the specific trichography results showing nodal swelling and invagination of the distal hair into the proximal end, could suggest Darier disease, a rare genetic disorder affecting the skin and hair.

shortlist.label: Keratosis pilaris
shortlist.why_kept: The presence of widespread skin involvement with erythematous plaques and the patient's age could also suggest keratosis pilaris, although it is less likely given the severity and specific findings in this case.

raw.rationale: The patient's presentation of widespread polycyclic serpiginous, erythematous plaques with a double-edged scale, sparse and short eyebrow hairs, and coarse and brittle scalp hairs, along with skin biopsy showing psoriasiform epidermal hyperplasia with spongiosis, is most consistent with Pityriasis rubra pilaris, which is characterized by these specific skin and hair findings.

rejected.label: Psoriasis vulgaris
rejected.why: While the skin biopsy shows psoriasiform epidermal hyperplasia, the clinical presentation and trichography findings are more suggestive of Pityriasis rubra pilaris

rejected.label: Ichthyosis vulgaris
rejected.why: The patient's skin findings are not typical of Ichthyosis vulgaris, which is characterized by dry, scaly skin without the specific plaques and hair abnormalities seen in this patient

rejected.label: Darier disease
rejected.why: The patient's presentation does not match the characteristic greasy, crusted papules and nail abnormalities seen in Darier disease

rejected.label: Keratosis pilaris
rejected.why: The patient's skin findings are more severe and widespread than those typically seen in Keratosis pilaris, which is characterized by small, rough patches on the skin
